seo.title: What we handle | TripAgent
seo.description: We book three things: Flights, Hotels and Visas. A named advisor looks after all three, until you are home.

hero.headingHtml:
You bring the why.
We handle the how.
hero.lede: We book three things: flights, hotels and visas. One named advisor holds all three, until you are home.

services.headingHtml: The front of the cabin is what we know best.
services.lede: Business and first are our specialty. Any cabin, the same care. We know the fares worth holding, the flat-bed that is genuinely flat, the routing that saves the connection.
items: A few good options, never a wall of results.
Fares held while you decide. Ticketed when you say yes.
Seats, meals, miles and lounges, sorted for you.
Changes and refunds by your advisor, not a queue.
services.imageAlt: Business-class cabin aboard a long-haul flight

services.headingHtml: From the right room to the whole villa.
services.lede: Hundreds of thousands of properties, and the judgement to pick the right one. The suite with the view. The rate you would not find alone. The welcome that says you were expected.
items: Negotiated rates below the public price.
Upgrades, late checkout and amenities, asked for ahead.
Villas, residences and connecting rooms for families.
Someone who has stayed there, or knows someone who has.
services.imageAlt: Palace hotel reflected in the lake at Udaipur

services.lede: The part that can turn a good trip into a worry. We check it, prepare it, file it and track it. We know the rules and the timelines, so a refusal or a missed window never costs you the trip.
items: Eligibility and documents checked against current rules.
Applications prepared and filed for you.
Status tracked, appointments managed, reminders sent.
Timed to your flights and hotels, so nothing clashes.
services.imageAlt: Passport and travel documents ready for a visa application

pq: The welcome that tells you that you were expected.

whyOnlyThree.headingHtml: We do three things. We do them completely.
whyOnlyThree.lede: Better to be flawless at flights, hotels and visas than passable at twenty things. More may come, but only at the same standard. And because one advisor holds all three, it all lines up: the visa timed to the flight, the flight timed to the room. Anything beyond these three, we are glad to research and arrange for you.

health.body: Some journeys are about the body, not the map. When a member is weighing the world's finest hospitals, specialists or longevity clinics, we help them navigate it: reading the field, opening the right doors, and arranging the flights, stays and visas around the visit.
health.note: This is guidance and coordination, not a service we sell. The care itself always rests with accredited providers and your own physicians: we never book medical treatment.
health.asideLede: Only three things are ever booked here: flights, hotels and visas. Everything else, this included, is research that helps you decide.

signature.lineHtml:
All three, looked after,
until you are home.
signature.sub: Most agents are gone the moment you pay. We stay: through departure, the 2 a.m. call, the homecoming. There for every step, including the ones no one else shows up for.
